alignments.note: Vocative construct noun takes the supplied *O* under rule 36.
Nomen rectum takes the chain's *of* under rule 19.
Article on the attributive rendered by the relative *that* under rule 41.
Passive participle with the copula and modal frame rule 20 supplies, headed on the lexical word. The margin's *that art laid waste* was read and set aside under rule 38.
Predicate noun of the beatitude with the construction-supplied copula frame under rule 20, discontinuous around the subject pronoun.

Written relative takes the *that* together with the supplied antecedent pronoun under rule 46's first rider, a present morpheme taking its English before a supplied reading does. The competing head is *he*.
Dative לְ rendered as a bare English object, so the preposition keeps nothing under rule 40.
Suffix takes the English object pronoun under rules 18 and 40.
Object marker with no English of its own under rule 16.
The cognate object noun is absorbed into the ASV's comparative recasting and is left unwritten; marked `unrepresented` under rule 22 rather than folded into the verb's rendering.
Suffix on that noun likewise left unwritten by the recasting.
Relative particle rendered by the comparative *As* that opens the recast clause.
Finite verb with its subject pronoun and auxiliary, headed on the lexical verb.
Dative לְ rendered as a bare English object under rule 40.
Suffix takes the English object pronoun.

review_notes: Every source and target id is partitioned once.

אֶת־גְּמוּלֵךְ has no English of its own once the ASV recasts שֶׁגָּמַלְתְּ לָנוּ as *As thou hast served us*; the noun and its suffix are marked `unrepresented` and the *As* is given to the relative שֶׁ.
